scope: Inspection in progress. Episode strips cover entire durations at roughly 6 Hz with selected exact anomaly times; exhaustive geometry analysis is separate. No asset has been accepted from these strips.

notes.air_walker: Final body is largely a fixed raised-arm posture with mechanical sagittal foot cycling; source is replaced by stand_idle. This is not independent generated motion.
notes.assist_elder_walk: Both participants remain close while stepping; body-only strip does not show grasp quality. No acceptance from this view.
notes.atm_keypad: One reach is held for most of the episode, with little visible pressing motion. Contact and keypad placement need props-visible review.
notes.atm_take_cash: Single forward reach and withdrawal are visible. Props are hidden, so hand/cash contact remains unverified.
notes.badminton_swing: Raised bent arm returns quickly around 1.5–1.7 seconds, with little clear extended striking motion. Needs source/final and racket contact review.
notes.basketball_dribble: Repeated arm strokes remain in one clip; the bent arm reaches head level and has a confirmed head-overlap flag.
notes.basketball_shoot: Long bent-arm hold near head; no clear full shooting arm extension. Body is authored over stand_idle, so raw source is not the displayed action.
notes.bike_scan_unlock: Only a forward reach and torso bend are visible; no clear scan-versus-unlock distinction. Prop placement is needed for assessment.
notes.breakfast_buy: A six-second two-person scripted transaction includes several reaches/exchanges; needs separation of reusable action units from full demonstration logic.
notes.breakfast_sell: Same complete transaction is staged from the seller entry. Multiple exchange phases are bundled together.
notes.browse_bookstall: Hand moves from front reach to face/chest, then back; elbow visibly changes branch near 3.55 seconds. Full metrics confirm final correction creates the jump.
notes.buy_newspaper: Arm extends nearly straight and remains extended at the end; item/handoff alignment and supported endpoint remain unverified.
notes.cafe_sit_drink: Starts seated with hands forward, raises one bent arm toward neck, and lowers it. Props-visible review needed for cup/mouth relationship.
notes.car_enter: Body is synthesized over stand_idle; leg splay and rigid upright torso do not establish a believable entry through the door. Whole six-second car sequence is scripted.
notes.car_exit: Reverse scripted seat-to-standing sequence over stand_idle; needs interaction unit and doorway/body-clearance review.
notes.carry_bag: Arm lowers from forward bent hold to near the side over the episode. Grip/body relationship requires the bag-visible capture; not a stable carrying hold throughout.
notes.carry_bags: Standing two-bag hold with very small body motion. Body-only view shows no gross failure, but grips and support remain unverified.
notes.carry_box: Standing two-arm forward hold. No large failure visible in the body-only view; box grips and endpoint need review.
notes.carry_bucket: One walking stride with arms close to the body and rearward torso lean. Bucket contact is not visible in this diagnostic.
notes.carry_shoulder: Standing bent-arm shoulder-carry hold; no acceptance without the load-visible view.
notes.carry_shoulder_bag: One walking stride; hand holds away from the shoulder in the front view. Strap/grip alignment needs props-visible review.
notes.chess_move: Seated reach is visible, then held and withdrawn; finger/piece action and board contact are not visible.
notes.chess_watch: Standing lean-in-and-back episode; body-only silhouette is plausible, but no acceptance of board arrangement.
notes.choose_item: Arm remains down with a small forward swing; selecting an object is scarcely visible in the body-only strip.
notes.crouch_check: Single standing-to-deep-crouch episode ends highly folded, with arms crowded near the knees. Needs support and endpoint review; no acceptance from static endpoint equality.
notes.crouch_check_hold: Deep crouch is held with small motion; front silhouette is crowded. Pose readability and limb/contact interpretation remain unresolved.
notes.distribute_flyer: Two-person exchange contains a recipient elbow branch change during the held contact near 2.55 seconds; contact metrics flag this participant, not only the main actor.
notes.dodge: One lean/duck and recovery from a guard pose; no gross body failure visible in this strip.
notes.drink: One raise, hold and partial withdrawal. Palm/prop orientation is essential to judge mouth contact; current body hold is close to neck.
notes.duck_cover_hold: Crouched arms are held behind/around the head, with a substantial gap in front view. Source versus target coverage remains unclear.
notes.eat_walk: One walking stride with a fixed raised hand near the neck. Bite action and mouth/food relationship cannot be accepted without the prop.
notes.elder_assisted_walk: Same two-person assisted stride; close participant overlap makes grasp and arm contact unclear in the front view.
notes.exercise: Trimmed cyclic jumping-jack period begins/ends with arms raised and body off the ground. Not a grounded independent rest endpoint.
notes.film_phone: Bent arms remain together at chest height for almost the entire five seconds. Phone orientation/recording direction requires props-visible review.
notes.football_juggle: Fixed torso and horizontal arms over stand_idle, with a mechanically authored leg lift. The independent NPZ is not the displayed action.
notes.fountain_drink: Both arms converge at neck while leaning forward; water source/mouth alignment is not verifiable with props hidden.
notes.fruit_choose: Long straight reach then withdrawal; little visible choosing/inspection distinction. Prop contact remains unverified.
notes.fruit_weigh: One reach with second arm joining; source gesture alone does not show weighing, requiring item/scale contact review.
notes.give_item: Recipient elbow abruptly changes bend during the held exchange and at withdrawal near 3.60 seconds. Metrics distinguish final correction from smoother source.
notes.grab_snatch: One forward reach held for about a second and then withdrawal; reads as reaching rather than a sharp snatch. No gross penetration confirmed by this view.
notes.hands_behind_back: Back-held hands read reasonably from side/front silhouette; no gross failure visible, not accepted without continuous/detail checks.
notes.hands_in_pockets: Standing pocket pose with small torso lean; no gross issue confirmed from this strip.
notes.hands_on_head: Forearms cross into the head during raise/hold; final head overlap is confirmed by complete metrics. Elbow shape changes abruptly during lowering.
notes.hands_on_head_hold: Held arms visibly change shape around 1.17–1.23 seconds despite nominal hold; mapping/contact continuity needs correction.
notes.hands_on_hips: Hip-held stance with slight lean; no gross failure visible. Crossed leg stance needs intentional-pose interpretation rather than automatic rejection.
notes.hands_up_hold: Raised bent arms read as surrender in front view. Previous generic claim that hands-up necessarily fails was too broad.
notes.handshake_offer: Both people approach to fixed contact, hold handshake and separate arms. Fixed participant placement/timing is not independently validated reusable interaction.
notes.handshake_reply: Same fixed paired handshake demonstration as offer. No independent contact adaptation is established.
notes.hang_laundry: Arms rise, hold, and lower with visible head crowding and abrupt bend changes. Complete metrics confirm head overlap and shortened limbs.
notes.hesitate_reach: Only a small low forward arm lift is visible; hesitation intent is weak in both views.
notes.hold_door: Arm reach/hold/withdrawal is authored over stand_idle; standalone source does not contain the shown action.
notes.hold_guitar: Nearly static asymmetric arm hold. Guitar grip and possible strumming cannot be evaluated with the object hidden.
notes.hold_umbrella: Bent front hand hold with tiny movement; umbrella shaft/grip and clearance require object-visible review.
